title: Production Manager / Shift Supervisor – Machine Shop
description:
**Company:** Sri Gowrish CNC Private Limited  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| Permanent  
**Experience:** 5–12 Years  
**Industry:** CNC Machining / Precision Engineering

Job Summary

Sri Gowrish CNC Private Limited is looking for an experienced **Production Manager / Shift Supervisor – Machine Shop** to manage CNC machining operations and lead shop\-floor production activities.

The candidate will be responsible for achieving production targets, optimizing manpower and machine utilization, maintaining quality standards, reducing downtime and rejection, and ensuring timely delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day\-to\-day CNC machine shop production activities.
* Handle **VMC, HMC, VTL and CNC Turning** operations.
* Plan and achieve daily, weekly and monthly production targets.
* Manage manpower allocation and shift operations.
* Monitor **OEE, productivity, rejection, rework, downtime and machine utilization**.
* Coordinate with PPC, Quality, Maintenance, Stores and Tool Room teams.
* Ensure proper utilization of tools, fixtures and machines.
* Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure production is carried out as per process and quality requirements.
* Maintain shift\-wise production reports and performance records.
* Drive **5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing and TPM** initiatives.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for machine breakdowns and preventive maintenance.
* Ensure shop\-floor safety, discipline and housekeeping.
* Lead, train and develop operators and production team members.
* Support productivity improvement, cost reduction and on\-time delivery initiatives.

**Shift Supervisor Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of production activities during the assigned shift.
* Allocate manpower based on machine and production requirements.
* Monitor hourly production against planned targets.
* Conduct shift\-start briefings and communicate production priorities.
* Monitor quality, rejection, rework and machine downtime.
* Ensure proper shift handover and communicate pending activities.
* Escalate production, quality, manpower and machine\-related issues promptly.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in **Mechanical / Production / Manufacturing Engineering**.
* **5–12 years of experience** in CNC machining or machine\-shop production.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **VMC, HMC, VTL and CNC Turning**.
* Experience in precision engineering, automotive or machining industries preferred.
* Good knowledge of production planning and manpower management.
* Knowledge of **OEE, productivity, rejection, rework and downtime analysis**.
* Knowledge of **5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing and TPM**.
* Strong leadership, communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently manage CNC machine\-shop operations.
* Willingness to work in shifts.

**Benefits**

* Competitive Salary
* Performance\-Based Appraisal
* PF \& ESI as applicable
* Group Insurance / Accident Insurance
* Canteen / Food Facility
* Training \& Development Opportunities
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Professional Working Environment

title: Production Supervisor – Hydraulics Assembly & Machine Shop Operations
description:
**Production Supervisor**

**(Hydraulics Assembly and Machine Shop Operations)**

ITI / Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical or Production Engineering with 10\+ years of experience in the manufacturing industry.

To manage and supervise daily production activities in **Hydraulics Assembly and Machine Shop operations**, ensuring production targets, product quality, on\-time delivery, proper use of manpower and machines, workplace safety, and continuous improvement.

**Roles and Responsibility:**

* Hydraulics Cylinder and Power Pack Assembly Operations:
* Supervise daily hydraulic cylinder and power pack assembly work.
* Ensure assembly is done as per drawings, BOM, work instructions, and quality requirements.
* Ensure proper fitting of pistons, rods, seals, valves, pumps, motors, manifolds, hoses, and fittings.
* Ensure proper hydraulic piping, tubing, and connections.
* Carry out and monitor pressure, leakage, flow, and functional testing.
* Identify and solve assembly and testing problems.
* Allocate manpower and monitor team productivity.
* Ensure required components, tools, fixtures, and consumables are available.
* Maintain assembly records, checklists, and test reports.
* Reduce rejection, rework, leakage, and assembly defects.
* Maintain 5S, housekeeping, safety, and PPE compliance.
* Train and guide operators on proper assembly and testing methods.
* Support productivity improvement and continuous improvement activities.

**Machine Shop Operations**

* Supervise machining activities carried out on: CNC Lathe, Conventional / Manual Lathe, H\-Boring Machine, DRO Machine, Honing Machine, Band saw Cutting Machine, VTL Machine, Radial Drilling Machine.
* Ensure machining is carried out as per approved drawings, process sheets, and specifications.
* Ensure correct machine settings, tooling, fixtures, cutting parameters, and work\-holding methods.
* Monitor machining cycle time and productivity.
* Ensure proper use and availability of cutting tools, measuring instruments, coolants, and consumables.
* Monitor component dimensions and coordinate with Quality for inspection.
* Identify machining problems and take corrective action to reduce rejection and rework.
* Ensure proper machine loading, unloading, and material handling.

**Machine \& Tool Management**

* Monitor machine condition and coordinate with Maintenance for breakdowns and repairs.
* Ensure preventive maintenance activities are carried out as per schedule.
* Monitor tool life and ensure timely replacement of worn\-out tools.
* Ensure proper use and storage of tools, fixtures, gauges, and measuring instruments.
* Report recurring machine problems and support corrective actions.

**Documentation \& Reporting:**

* Maintain daily production reports and machine\-wise production records.
* Monitor and report production quantity, rejection, rework, downtime, and productivity.
* Maintain job cards, process records, and shift handover reports.
* Monitor raw material and component availability for production.
* Report production delays and bottlenecks to the Production Manager.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly production performance reports as required.

**Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of hydraulic cylinder assembly and hydraulic components.
* Knowledge of CNC and conventional machining processes.
* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings.
* Knowledge of machining tools, fixtures, and cutting parameters.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments such as Vernier Calliper, Micro meter, Bore Gauge, Height Gauge, etc.
* Knowledge of hydraulic pressure and leakage testing.

**Compensation:** 

* Salary is not a constraint for the right candidate and will be commensurate with experience and expertise.

**Work location:**

* Malumichampatti, Coimbatore \- 641050

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Hydraulics Assembly: 5 years (Required)
* Machine Shop Operations: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Retail Operations Manager
description:
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced **Operations Manager** to oversee the day\-to\-day functioning of our retail pharmacy outlets. The role is responsible for infrastructure and facility upkeep, manpower planning, customer service, financial coordination, sales growth, and store compliance — ensuring smooth, efficient, and profitable store operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Infrastructure and Facility Management**

* Ensure store premises, equipment, and fixtures are well\-maintained and fully functional
* Coordinate repairs, maintenance, and vendor visits for store infrastructure (AC, refrigeration/cold chain, POS systems, etc.)
* Ensure adherence to safety, hygiene, and housekeeping standards
* Monitor utility costs and ensure optimal upkeep of store assets

**2\. Manpower Planning and Employee Management**

* Plan staffing levels and duty rosters to ensure adequate coverage at all times
* Recruit, onboard, train, and supervise pharmacists, pharmacy assistants, and support staff
* Conduct performance reviews, identify training needs, and support career development
* Manage attendance, leave, and discipline in line with HR policies
* Foster a professional, customer\-first team culture

**3\. Customer Service and Escalation Handling**

* Ensure customers receive accurate information and courteous service on medicines and health products
* Handle escalated customer complaints and ensure timely resolution
* Monitor customer feedback and implement service improvement measures
* Uphold service quality standards across all customer touchpoints

**4\. Accounts and Financial Coordination**

* Oversee POS billing, cash handling, and daily reconciliation processes
* Coordinate with the accounts/finance team on store\-level financial reporting
* Monitor store budgets and operational expenses
* Support audits and ensure accuracy of financial records at store level

**5\. Sales and Business Development Initiatives**

* Monitor sales performance and drive strategies to achieve revenue and footfall targets
* Coordinate with marketing teams on promotions, seasonal campaigns, and new product launches
* Identify opportunities for upselling OTC/wellness products
* Build local outreach initiatives to grow customer base

**6\. Store Operations, Compliance, and Administrative Functions**

* Oversee day\-to\-day store operations to ensure smooth and efficient functioning
* Ensure compliance with pharmacy regulations, licensing requirements, and drug\-handling protocols
* Coordinate with the SCM team on stock levels, replenishment, and discrepancies; conduct store\-level audits
* Implement and monitor SOPs across store functions
* Maintain accurate records and documentation for regulatory inspections and audits
* Prepare and submit operational and compliance reports to senior management

**7\. Any Other Operational Responsibilities**

* Undertake any other operational duties or projects as assigned by senior management from time to time

**Requirements:**

* 5–8 years of overall work experience
* Experience in retail store operations preferred (any retail background is fine, not necessarily pharmacy)
* Prior experience handling/overseeing 10–15 stores or multi\-location operations
* Experience in team management, daily operations, and performance monitoring
* Experience handling customer complaints, escalations, and service\-related issues
* Good understanding of SOP implementation, KPI tracking, and operational reporting
* Experience working with multiple departments (SCM, finance, HR, marketing) to resolve operational issues
* Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and operational MIS
* Willingness to travel to HealthSy Pharmacy stores as required
* Should be based out of Coimbatore or willing to relocate
* **Interested candidates can share their cv to careers@healthsypharmacy.com**

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
